title: Edu-RPG weekly packet 1
lede: Eight choices only you can make, what was decided for you this week, and four things to try if you have ten spare minutes. Tap an option and it is saved.

status.headline: Build 99 plays from the title to the ending at every grade. The blockers are fixed. What is left is feel, balance and art.

tiles.k: Build on TestFlight since Tue 24 Nov
Story steps passed by the robot, title to ending
Boss and zone numbers inside their targets at grades 1, 3 and 6
Jump checks passed across every town and dungeon floor

blocks.title: New in build 99
lines: Number keypad and notepad for quiz answers.
The Demon King can be beaten. In build 98 the robot lost 300 fights out of 300.
21 quests that could not start, finish or pay now work.
Boss and quest rewards are no longer lost when the bag is full.
Continue no longer moves her on the world map or forgets her dungeon floor.
Longer lightning and gust warnings for grades K to 2.

blocks.title: Done since, waiting for build 100
lines: All checks pass on these changes, and the robot again played from the title to the ending (248 steps), this time with no second tries.
Lightning, gust and magma warnings by grade, now for grades 3 to 6 too.
The typed answer sits on its own line above Correct!
Demon Castle: hugging the wall, she stopped dead on the base of a mirror frame at 31 of 32 doorways. She now walks through.
The healers at Last Bastion and Cinderwatch stand behind a stall, and Talk only showed from one exact spot beside them. The spot is now more than twice as big.

blocks.title: Not there yet
lines: Acts 2 to 5 art is behind Act 1: coasts without sand, nine towns sharing two map icons, every field boss the same smoke ball. These need painted art from the Mac.
The robot measures timing and numbers. It does not yet judge whether a screen looks good.
How fast a child types on the keypad is my assumption, not a measurement.
Mac builds are still put together by hand.

choicesIntro: Nothing here has a ruling from you yet. Skip any you like: the line under each says what happens with no answer.

choices.q: Act 5: where does the compass send her after Last Bastion?
choices.why: Build 98 could not reach the Barracks quests at all. Build 99 follows the quest chain as written, which puts two six-floor dungeons and a hunt for 10 demons before the first portal.

options.label: Demon Barracks, Void Rift, then the portals
options.detail: The quest chain as written. In build 99.

options.label: Straight to the four portals
options.detail: Barracks and Rift stay open as optional side dungeons.

choices.q: After the Crystal Cave boss, where does the compass point?
choices.why: The Sage in Millbrook gave the quest and pays 100 gold for the report. Ironkeep is the next town in the story.

options.label: Back to the Sage, then Ironkeep
options.detail: She reports in person and gets her 100 gold. In build 99.

options.label: On to Ironkeep
options.detail: The report waits in the quest log for a player who walks back.

choices.q: Seven story quests have nobody who gives them. How should they work?
choices.why: The Mountain Pass, Into the Shadow, The Desert Tomb, The Magma Path, The Volcanic Forge, The Four Relics and The Final Battle. In build 98 none of them could start.

options.label: They start and end by themselves
options.detail: A New Quest notice when the quest before is done, a reward card when the boss falls. In build 99.

options.label: Townspeople give them
options.detail: The Ironkeep blacksmith, the Oasis elder, the Forgemaster and others ask and thank. New lines in three languages, and a walk back to report after each boss.

options.label: Take them out of the quest log
options.detail: The bosses still gate the story. The log lists only quests a person gave.

choices.q: Random fights from the second dungeon to Act 4 barely hurt. What should change?
choices.why: A fight there costs 0.1 to 3% of her HP, yet these fights are most of the play time: 500 to 870 fights and 3 to 4 hours of quiz questions in one playthrough.

options.label: Leave them
options.detail: Easy fights are quiz practice. In build 99.

options.label: Fewer fights, same rewards
options.detail: About 40% fewer fights, each paying more XP and gold. Same level at every boss, 1 to 1.5 hours shorter.

options.label: Same number, more dangerous
options.detail: A wrong defence answer costs about 6% of her HP. She will need heal items in every dungeon.

choices.q: She reaches the first big shop nearly broke. Change it?
choices.why: At Port Sapphire she has 41 to 65 gold and the four upgrades cost 80 to 200. In 14 of 15 test runs she could buy none. The Crystal Cave then pays 640 to 740 gold at once.

options.label: Leave it
options.detail: Wanting something she cannot afford yet is part of an RPG. In build 99.

options.label: Pocket money in Act 1
options.detail: The Owl's Lesson quest pays 100 gold more, so one upgrade is affordable when she arrives.

options.label: Move chest gold earlier
options.detail: About 300 of the Crystal Cave's chest gold moves into the Whispering Woods Cave and Misty Grotto chests. Same total.

choices.q: How often should a child beat the Demon King on the first try?
choices.why: Build 98: never. Build 99: about two tries in three. A loss restarts the fight with her HP and items as they were at its start.

options.label: About 2 in 3
options.detail: Build 99, typing on the keypad. Grade 1 wins about 69%, grade 3 about 53%, grade 6 about 69% of 100 fights each.

options.label: About 4 in 5
options.detail: Gentler. Most children win the first time.

options.label: About 1 in 2
options.detail: A real final boss. Half the children need a second try.

choices.q: Guards and trip wires catch the test child every time. Make the tells clearer?
choices.why: Demon Barracks 4F and 6F: a guard pauses 0.55 s, then turns his lantern. Bandit Hideout 4F: a trip wire shows from 2 tiles away, about 0.4 s at walking speed. The robot's grade 1 and grade 3 child was caught on 12 tries out of 12 on each floor. Being caught costs one battle.

options.label: Leave them
options.detail: Getting caught is cheap and part of the dungeon. In build 99.

options.label: Clearer tells
options.detail: A guard swings his lantern before he turns, longer for younger grades. A wire glints from 4 tiles away.

choices.keepsVerb: the robot builds, behind a switch, and shows you

choices.q: Stormreach Spire's narrow floors still strike her on most crossings. Ease them?
choices.why: With this week's longer warnings a floor costs her about a tenth of her HP instead of more than half. On 3F, 4F and 6F fewer than half of the crossings are clean at any grade. A strike is a little damage and one step back.

options.label: Leave them
options.detail: Being struck now and then is what the Spire is.

options.label: Shorter bolts
options.detail: A bolt is dangerous for half as long. Same glow, same rhythm.

options.label: Fewer bolts on those floors
options.detail: Fewer stones strike at the same time.

decidedIntro: Changes the taste guide or a plain defect covered, so they went in without asking. Each has a switch. Tap Undo this and it comes out in the next build.

decided.title: Towns fill the screen when she walks in
decided.text: Coming in by a south gate she now stands low on screen, so the black strip under the town is gone.

images.alt: Greenhollow gate with a black strip under the town
Greenhollow gate, the town reaches the tab bar

decided.title: Dungeon mouths glow warm
decided.text: The way out of an Acts 2 to 5 dungeon was a hard white edge. It is now a soft warm light. A painted arch like Act 1's is the proper version and is on the art list; the warm tint looks a little odd in ice caves.

images.alt: Iron Mine exit with a hard white edge
Iron Mine exit with a soft warm glow

decided.title: The Quests panel folds when it is empty
decided.text: With no active quest the panel is one small button. The Saved pill moved under the compass.

images.alt: Open Quests panel reading No active quests
Quests panel folded to a small button

decided.title: Japanese on the talk, shop and save buttons
decided.text: In Japanese mode these buttons were still English.

images.alt: Button reading Talk to Elder Rowan in Japanese mode
Button reading 長老と 話す

decided.title: Warnings last longer for younger grades
decided.where: K to 2 in build 99, 3 to 6 in build 100
decided.text: Your rule: built for small hands. The lightning glow and the magma cracks now last 1.5 s for grades K to 2 and 1.25 s for grades 3 and 4, the terrace stays calm for a moment after each strike, and Storm Nest gusts blow less often. Grade 3 clean crossings of Spire 5F went from 2 in 20 to 15 in 20; grade 1 on Magma Tunnels 5F from 3 in 12 to 12 in 12. She also cannot be struck in her first 2.5 s on a Spire floor.

decided.title: The Demon King is beatable, and fast answers still crit
decided.text: His HP went from 1,875 to 1,500, his poison from 5% to 2% a turn, and his charged hit is weaker. With the keypad, a right answer inside 4.5 s is a critical hit (it was 3 s, which typing made almost impossible for a grade 6 child).

decided.title: The typed answer gets its own line
decided.text: Build 99 runs the number into the message.

images.alt: The number 10 on its own line above Correct! Knowledge restored!

decided.title: Small ones
decided.text: Tower floors count up (1F, 2F) and caves count down (B1F, B2F). People block like a body, not a square. Three shopkeepers can be talked to across the counter. A quest that ends by itself after a boss shows a Quest Complete card with a Continue adventure button.

play.title: If you have ten minutes
play.intro: In build 99 open Settings, then Testers: Jump to. Each stop takes two or three minutes. The jump hero is a grade 3 child. Your own adventure is auto saved first.

stops.title: Lightning at grade 3, before this week's fix
stops.look: Build 99 still has the old grade 3 timing here: the stone glows for under a second before the bolt. The robot's grade 3 child crossed clean 2 times in 20. Build 100 glows for 1.25 s. Does the old timing feel unfair to you too?

stops.title: Do the gusts still read?
stops.look: The streaks are now soft and pale blue, near her and under the fog, instead of white dashes over the HUD. Nobody has watched them in motion. Is the gust still a clear cue to stop?

stops.title: Keypad answers
stops.look: Type the answer and press Attack. Try the notepad key. Known flaw in build 99: the typed number runs into Correct!

stops.title: The Demon King
stops.look: One fight. Plain play takes 4 to 6 minutes and wins about two in three. Careful defend-and-heal play almost always wins at grade 1 but takes about 9 minutes. Is that the right length for the last boss?
